message: Hi, my little one Wil is 6 and wants to try karate. Do you have classes for that age?

Hi! That's awesome that Wil wants to try martial arts! We have Kids Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes that are perfect for 6-year-olds. They're grouped by age with instruction designed just for them. Would you like to book a free trial class so Wil can check it out?
Yes, a free trial class sounds great! What time slots do you have available?
Perfect! I just need a few quick details to get your trial set up. What's your name?

Great, thanks Tester! And what's the best emaii to send the trial details to?
*email
Perfect! And what's the best phone number to reach you at?
Got it! And just to confirm, is Wil's full name just Wil, or is that short for something?
Perfect! And what's Wil's date of birth? This helps us make sure he's in the right age group.

Awesome! I have Wil all set for the Kids Beginner Karate class. Here are a few open slots this week:

Tuesday 7/7 at 4:45 PM
Wednesday 7/8 at 5:15 PM
Saturday 7/11 at 8:30 AM

Which works best for you?
Let's go with Tuesday 7/7 at 4:45 PM. Thank you!
Perfect! Wil is all booked for Tuesday 7/7 at 4:45 PM. I'll send the details to tester.basalt@gmail.com. See you then!
